headline: Blow to Sofia residents' wallets: Property tax assessments jump and property deals become more expensive from next year
summary: Property tax assessments in Sofia are set to jump, and property transactions will become more expensive from next year under the new financial framework. The changes were reported by Actualno.com.
why: Municipal property taxes and transfer costs affect real estate values, transaction volumes and household costs in the city.
